items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I’m sure it has. It’s kind of like what we spoke about earlier, an integration, and Jackie Robinson getting into the pro leagues.

ctx.x: What do you think jazz education has done for the music as far as — we’ve got lots of places to go now to study and to be a jazz musician. Has it changed the way the music is developing do you think?
I’m sure it has. It’s kind of like what we spoke about earlier, an integration, and Jackie Robinson getting into the pro leagues.
